name: Anastasia Volkov
bio:
Anastasia Volkov's motorsport journey began in the icy landscapes of Siberia, where she developed a fascination for engineering and speed. Tinkering with engines in her father's garage ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in high-performance vehicles. After graduating with honors, Anastasia quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a junior engineer at a small racing team before demonstrating exceptional leadership and technical acumen. 

Known for her meticulous attention to detail and data-driven decision-making, Anastasia approaches her role as team principal with a blend of strategic foresight and hands-on involvement. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. Her distinctive ability to identify and nurture talent, coupled with her relentless pursuit of innovation, sets her apart in the competitive world of motorsport. Anastasia is a rising star, determined to make her mark on the sport.

Anastasia is a force of nature, her leadership style is direct and effective. She quickly adapts to new regulations and challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Long, sleek ponytail, often with stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: She is tall and slender with sharp, intelligent eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering diagrams and calculations.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against the table when deep in thought.
